changelog:
Version 7.8.69

Improvements

  • Sharper, smaller main images. The resized copies APO makes of the page's main image are now created with a higher-quality resizing method: noticeably closer to the original and usually smaller in file size. Existing copies are rebuilt once automatically after the update.
  • A better-fitting image size for high-resolution phones, so modern phones no longer download the desktop-size copy.
